[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part V · Suits Relating to Immovable Property
 Section: 62::Twelve years.
]


To enforce payment of money secured by a mortgage or otherwise charged upon immovable property.
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the money sued for becomes due.
